entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:1
segments: If a prophet rises among you, or a dreamer of dreams, and gives you a sign or a wonder,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:2
segments: and the sign or the wonder which he foretold to you occurs, saying, Let us go after other gods which you have not known, and let us serve them,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:3
segments: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams. For the LORD your God [is] testing you to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:4
segments: You shall walk after the LORD your God and fear Him, and keep His commandments, and obey His voice, and you shall serve Him and hold fast to Him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:5
segments: And that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has spoken to turn [you] away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of slaves, to thrust you out of the way in which the LORD your God commanded you to walk. So you shall put the evil away from the midst of you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:6
segments: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who [is] like your own soul, lures you secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:7
segments: that is, of the gods of the people who [are] around you, near you or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:8
segments: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him. Nor shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare, nor shall you hide him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:9
segments: But you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:10
segments: And you shall stone him with stones so that he dies, because he has sought to drive you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:11
segments: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:12
segments: If, in one of your cities which the LORD your God has given you to dwell in, you shall hear [one] saying,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:13
segments: Men, the sons of Belial, have gone out from among you and have drawn away those who live in their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:14
segments: then you shall inquire and make search, and ask carefully. And behold, [if it is true], and the thing is certain, [that] such an abomination is done among you,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:15
segments: you shall surely strike those who live in that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it completely, and all that [is] in it, and all the cattle of it, with the edge of the sword.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:16
segments: And you shall gather all its spoil into the middle of its street, and shall burn the city with fire, and all its spoil, every bit of it, for the LORD your God. And it shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:17
segments: And let nothing of the cursed thing cling to your hand, so that the LORD may turn from the heat of his anger and show you mercy, and give mercies to you, and multiply you as He has sworn to your fathers,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:18
segments: when you listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep all His commandments which I command you today, to do the right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
